//: The section is 'Morgana:LLM' and not 'Alembic:LLM' because MorganaLLM reads that path:
Alembic consumes the framework's own provider abstraction rather than reimplementing it.
Only the Performance tier is declared — Alembic writes dispositive prose and runs once per
onboarding, so it never uses the Efficiency die. A single-tier deployment therefore does
not serve Alembic until a Performance entry exists (no cross-tier fallback, by design).
MagicDust pricing is declared because TierDefinition requires it, not because Alembic
meters anything: there is no conversation here to charge a budget to.
Declaring Efficiency here as well was tried and is wrong. This is the same section a Morgana
instance configures, so a shared store (in-repo, the user secrets Alembic borrows from
Morgana.Web) does set an Efficiency ModelId, which then binds against no MagicDust and yields
a half-populated tier. That costs one chat client Alembic never asks for and nothing else,
since GetPricing is never called for it. Declaring Efficiency instead makes the standalone
case fail hard: an operator who configures only the tier Alembic uses leaves the other on its
placeholder, and MorganaLLM.RegisterTierClient refuses to start. Harmless beats fatal.
